text:
Priya (New Hire): Hi team — quick heads up. My H-1B petition was approved for Redwood's SF office but the client asked me to start onsite in Austin. Do we need an amendment before I travel?
Sam (People Ops): Congrats on the approval, Priya. Short answer: usually yes if the worksite is a material change (different metro area). We need to assess location, client address, and duties. Tom, is the Austin site a long-term placement (>60 days)?
Tom (Hiring Manager): Yep, it'll be for the client engagement for at least 6 months. Onsite 100% of the time.
Lina (Immigration Counsel): Because it's a different metropolitan statistical area (SF->Austin), an H-1B amendment + new LCA posting is required. We'll prepare the amendment filing. Expect ~7-10 business days to gather documents before submission.
Priya (New Hire): OK — do I need to pause travel until it's approved? Client expects me onsite next Monday.
Sam (People Ops): We can't advise you to travel to start working on a material-site move until amendment is filed at minimum. If you travel before approval and start work, that's risky for H-1B compliance. Discuss remote onboarding timing with the client; we can request a 2-week grace.
Raj (Recruiter): Client aware, asking for remote-first first week while we file. They're open to remote ramp for 10 business days.
Lina (Immigration Counsel): For filing we'll need: 1) client site address, 2) detailed onsite duties, 3) Priya's passport + I-94 copy, 4) current approved H-1B I-797, 5) recent pay stubs or offer letter. Sam, can People Ops collect docs and post the LCA notice?
Sam (People Ops): On it. Priya, please DM your passport page + I-94 + current I-797. upload-bot: priya uploaded files: passport_priya_20260201.pdf, i94_priya_20260201.pdf, i797_priya_20260405.pdf
Sam (People Ops): Thanks. Lina, client address is 300 E 4th St, Austin, TX 78701. Duties are in the email thread I forwarded. We'll also post the 10-business-day LCA notice for internal comment per policy.
Lina (Immigration Counsel): Perfect. We'll draft LCA and amendment. Note: LCA can be certified in ~7 business days; amendment filing can happen after LCA cert.
Priya (New Hire): About relocation reimbursement — if amendment delays my onsite start, can I still get reimbursed for flights/hotel booked? I already bought a ticket.
Sam (People Ops): Payroll policy: refundable relocation expenses require authorization before purchase. For exceptions, we can process as an advance or ad-hoc taxable reimbursement once you provide receipts. @payroll-bot — what's our recommendation?
payroll-bot: Payroll guidance: If work authorization is pending for the required site change, reimbursements may be processed as a taxable non-payroll reimbursement until amendment approval. To request, submit expenses with a note and cc people-ops. For non-taxable relocation, we need amendment approval and start date documentation.
Priya (New Hire): Got it. I'll file an expense with receipts and mark as taxable if needed.
Tom (Hiring Manager): If this helps speed things, client can provide a rapid onboarding letter confirming remote-first week and intended onsite start after two weeks. I'll have that now.
Lina (Immigration Counsel): That client letter is helpful for our filing and to show intent. Once we have LCA cert + client letter + docs we can file amendment. Expected timeline: docs gather 3 business days, LCA cert 5-7, file amendment immediately after.
Sam (People Ops): I'll post the internal LCA notice today (10-business-day window). Priya, please review the client letter for accuracy before we attach to the filing.
Priya (New Hire): Uploaded the client onboarding letter and my receipts to DM. upload-bot: priya uploaded files: client_onboard_letter_austin.pdf, flight_receipt_20260501.pdf
Lina (Immigration Counsel): Received. Priya please confirm full legal name and address as on passport for the filing.
Priya (New Hire): Confirming: Priya Patel, DOB 1995-08-12, passport name exactly 'Priya Patel'.
Sam (People Ops): Thanks — I'll finalize the draft declaration for you to e-sign. Once filed we'll share the receipt notice (I-797C) which you can use for provisional payroll/benefits notes if needed.
Raj (Recruiter): Let me know if client needs any more docs to avoid the travel pause.
Tom (Hiring Manager): I'll send the remote-first confirmation to the client now.
Sam (People Ops): Closing action items: collect documents (Sam/Priya), post LCA notice (Sam), obtain LCA cert (Lina), file amendment (Lina), process expense as taxable advance or hold until approval (Payroll). We'll update thread when amendment is filed. :white_check_mark:
